name: @picloom/package-rules
description: Browser-safe package validation, localization and draft-value rules

scripts.build: bun -e 'await require("node:fs/promises").rm("dist", {recursive: true, force: true})' && bun build index.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
